stepTitle: The Moon’s craters are remnants of meteorite collisions. Suppose a fairly large asteroid that has a mass of $$5.00\times10**{12}\,\text{kg}$$ (about a kilometer across) strikes the Moon at a speed of $$15.0\,\text{km/s}.$$ At what speed does the Moon recoil after the perfectly inelastic collision (the mass of the Moon is $$7.36\times10**{22}\,\text{kg})?$$ Give the speed to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
